mission_meta.description: Glitch-Hunters found a vulnerability in a test server. They need someone to document it properly. Not about money - it's about the bug hunt!

briefing.email_body:

but i need someone to go in and properly document the exploit, test the boundaries, and write up a proper disclosure report.

can you help?? :3

i can pay 400 credits (not a lot i know but research funding is tight lol) AND you'll get credited on the disclosure!!

this is gonna be SO COOL

bug hunting!! :3

.exploit_notes.txt.name: .exploit_notes.txt
.exploit_notes.txt.content:
GLITCH-HUNTERS VULNERABILITY DISCLOSURE DRAFT
============================================

CVE-Request: RESERVED
Discovery: Buffer (buffer@gh.labs)
Documented by: TBD

VULNERABILITY CLASS: Buffer Overread / Memory Disclosure
SEVERITY: HIGH (7.5/10)

AFFECTED SYSTEM:
- Product: TestBank Authentication System v3.0 Beta
- Environment: Testing (possibly affects production)

TECHNICAL DETAILS:
- Malformed packets to port 8080 trigger improper memory reads
- Authentication responses leak adjacent memory contents
- Exposed data includes: session tokens, partial credentials, user PII

REPRODUCTION:
1. Send crafted packet with length field = -1
2. Server reads beyond intended buffer boundary
3. Response includes 256 bytes of adjacent memory

EXPLOITABILITY:
- Remote: Yes
- Authentication: Not required
- Impact: Data exposure, potential session hijacking

RECOMMENDATION:
Patch authentication parser to validate packet length before processing.

---
This vulnerability was discovered during responsible disclosure testing.
Please contact TestBank security team before public release.

DISCLAIMER: For educational and security research purposes only.

guide.message: Glitch-Hunters! They're so excited about bugs, it's cute. Read Buffer's brief on your terminal.
A buffer overread exposing user data! That's serious, nya~. Connect to 'ssh 203.0.113.50' with password 't3stB4nk2025!'
You're in! Buffer found something interesting here - let's explore and see what we're dealing with.
Test credentials. Not useful for exploit, but good context. Check the debug logs - Buffer said there's a buffer overread.
There it is! Memory disclosure vulnerability. The auth system is leaking user data. Check the vulnerability directory for full report.
Buffer's already written most of it! Just needs your name as co-discoverer. Download with 'download .exploit_notes.txt' to complete the disclosure. Science!! :3
